title: In this world, you're trapped inside an "In this world" video.
formula: Strange act (punching the edge of the screen) -> why (a looping 'In this world' video, the red bar; loop 9,000) -> doubter (Gary walks by at the same second every loop: nobody leaves before the end) -> opponent (the narrator: he reads every caption aloud and whatever follows 'In this world' comes true) -> the rule used against you (painted doors, soup shoes) -> your plan, shown plainly (steal caption words into a jar: IN THIS WORLD YOU'RE, one word missing: FREE, which he never says) -> the bait (you fake loving it, he gloats 'you'll never be free', you snatch FREE out of the caption) -> setback (he freezes you) -> tension (the red bar 90-99 %) -> the doubter's habit saves you (Gary at the same second, his ladder smashes the jar) -> the narrator's own rule frees you (he reads the spilled words aloud) -> twist: you escape into the next video, loop 1
loop: Line 1: you're punching the edge of the screen on loop 9,000. Last: you escape into the next video, loop 1, and raise your fist at its edge: the punch starts again.
facts: Fiction: no sources needed. Rules, each said once and shown before it matters: (1) the video loops when the red bar hits the end; (2) the narrator reads every caption out loud, and whatever he reads after 'In this world' comes true; (3) Gary walks the same path at the same second every loop. Nothing else is magic.

Caption colours: key words yellow in narration; on a line with `speaker` they take the speaker's colour (narrator red, Gary blue, you green), so the viewer always knows when the narrator is talking as himself.
One place: the street (tally wall, shop door, Gary's path with its chalk X, the narrator's caption sign over it). Then the next video.

lines.narration: You're punching the edge of the *screen*.
lines.scene: Cold open, MCU: your fist slams into the edge of the frame itself; the picture wobbles like jelly and a crack spiders across the corner. Face: angry. At ~1 s, hard cut down to the red progress bar along the bottom of the frame, already filling: the threat.
lines.camera: Punch-in on the fist hitting the frame edge, hard cut to the progress bar
lines.gag: The frame edge ripples like glass where you hit it

lines.narration: Because you're stuck inside an "In this world" video, and when the red bar hits the end, it *loops*.
lines.spoken: Because you're stuck inside an 'In this world' video, and when the red bar hits the end... it loops.
lines.scene: The red bar hits the end; the whole street rewinds with tape wobble, birds flying backwards, and you snap back to mid-punch. Face: shocked -> crying.
lines.camera: Wide on the street as it rewinds, whip back to your face
lines.gag: The whole street rewinds, birds flying backwards

lines.narration: This is loop *9,000*.
lines.scene: The street wall next to you is covered in chalk tally marks; you add one more and the chalk snaps. Face: tired -> deadpan.
lines.camera: Slow pull-out along the tally wall
lines.gag: The chalk snaps on mark 9,000

lines.narration: Gary walks by with his ladder at the same second, every single *loop*.
lines.scene: Gary (overalls, long ladder, soup mug) strolls the exact same line as always; two grooves are worn into the cobbles by his feet. Plant: a small chalk X sits right beside the grooves (you drew it; nobody explains it). You jog beside him, pleading.
lines.camera: Tracking side-on with Gary, ladder sweeping past the lens
lines.gag: Gary's footsteps have worn grooves into the cobbles

lines.narration: "Nobody leaves before the end, *kid*,"
lines.speaker: gary
lines.scene: Gary says it without looking at you; you mouth every word along with him, in perfect sync. Faces: Gary deadpan; you disgusted.
lines.camera: Two-shot, slow push
lines.gag: You mouth his line along with him, word for word

lines.narration: he says, for the 9,000th *time*.
lines.spoken: he says, for the nine-thousandth time.
lines.scene: Hold the two-shot; you roll your eyes.
lines.camera: Slow push continues

lines.narration: And nobody beats the narrator. That's *me*.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The sky dims; the narrator's giant caption sign rises over the street, eyes opening on it. Your face: nervous, sweat drop.
lines.camera: Low angle, tilt up as the sign rises
lines.gag: The narrator's sign towers over you like a billboard

lines.narration: I read every caption out loud, and whatever comes after "In this world" comes *true*.
lines.spoken: I read every caption out loud, and whatever comes after 'In this world'... comes true.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The sign glows IN THIS WORLD; the caption under the picture lights up word by word as he reads it, and the sign's eyes follow the words.
lines.camera: Slow crane around the sign
lines.gag: The sign's eyes read along with the caption

lines.narration: "In this world, every door is painted *on*."
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: You sprint at a shop door and smack flat into it: it's a painting. You slide down it. Face: determined -> ring eyes.
lines.camera: Follow you into the door, hard cut on the splat
lines.gag: The door is a painting; you slide down it

lines.narration: "In this world, your shoes are full of *soup*."
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Close-up on your sneaker: you lift it and tomato soup sloshes over the rim and pours out into a puddle. Then tilt up: behind you, Gary sips from his mug: it's soup too. Face: disgusted.
lines.camera: Low close-up on the shoe, cut to a tilt up to your face
lines.gag: Gary's mug is full of soup too

lines.narration: So for 9,000 loops, you've been jumping up and stealing words out of the *captions*.
lines.spoken: So for nine-thousand loops, you've been jumping up and stealing words out of the captions.
lines.scene: You leap at the caption under the picture and yank one glowing word out of it; the caption is left with a gap. Face: scheming.
lines.camera: Low angle, the jump framed against the caption
lines.gag: A caption on screen is missing a word

lines.narration: You keep them in a jar. In. This. World. *You're*.
lines.scene: Close on a glass jar under your arm: four glowing word tiles inside, IN / THIS / WORLD / YOU'RE; you tap each one as it is read. One empty slot at the end.
lines.camera: Insert on the jar, rack along the tiles
lines.gag: The jar has one empty slot

lines.narration: You need just one more *word*.
lines.scene: Still on the jar: the empty slot at the bottom holds a '?' tile that pulses on 'word'; your thumb taps it. Face: scheming.
lines.camera: Jar insert continues, creeping in on the '?' slot
lines.gag: The empty slot is a '?' tile

lines.narration: And I never, ever say *free*.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The sign smirks down at you, eyelids half shut.
lines.camera: Low angle on the smug sign
lines.gag: The caption sign smirks

lines.narration: So this loop, you look up at the sign and *yell*,
lines.scene: You throw your arms wide, a huge fake smile, like you're on holiday.
lines.camera: Wide, you small under the sign

lines.narration: "I never want to *leave*!"
lines.speaker: you
lines.scene: You hug a lamp post lovingly; Gary stares at you.
lines.camera: Two-shot with Gary's stare
lines.gag: You hug a lamp post like it's family

lines.narration: And I can't *resist*. "In this world, you'll never be..."
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The sign leans down, delighted. His whole sentence pops up in the caption first, IN THIS WORLD, YOU'LL NEVER BE FREE, the last word glowing, and he starts reading it.
lines.camera: Push in on the sign as it gloats
lines.spoken: And I can't resist. "In this world, you'll never be..."

lines.narration: You snatch *free* out of the caption, mid-sentence.
lines.scene: You leap and pull FREE out of the caption before he gets to it; he's left saying 'you'll never be...' and nothing happens; the sign's mouth hangs open. You slot FREE into the jar: IN THIS WORLD YOU'RE FREE. Face: excited.
lines.camera: Low angle on the jump, cut to the jar filling
lines.gag: The narrator is stuck mid-sentence with a gap where FREE was

lines.narration: Then I *notice*.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Close on the sign's eyes: they snap wide open and swivel onto you. Cut to you, jar in hand, sweating. Face: nervous.
lines.camera: Close on the sign's eyes, cut to a push-in on you
lines.gag: The caption sign turns to look at you

lines.narration: "In this world, you can't *move*."
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: You freeze grey mid-step, jar raised; only your eyes still move. You're frozen standing on the chalk X beside Gary's grooves. Face: pinpoint eyes.
lines.camera: Slow arc around the frozen you, ending on your feet on the X
lines.gag: Only your eyes can still move

lines.narration: The red bar crawls. 90%. 95%. *99*.
lines.spoken: The red bar crawls. Ninety-percent. Ninety-five. Ninety-nine.
lines.scene: The red bar swells thick along the bottom; a big red percentage jumps 90%, 95%, 99% at its tip; your eyes dart to it and back.
lines.camera: Hard cuts between the bar and your eyes
lines.gag: The bar swells and a big percentage jumps on each number

lines.narration: And at 99, Gary walks by. Same second as *always*.
lines.spoken: And at ninety-nine, Gary walks by. Same second as always.
lines.scene: Gary strolls his grooves on time, ladder on his shoulder; it swings toward your frozen hand. You, frozen, can only smile with your eyes.
lines.camera: Low angle, Gary entering past the lens
lines.gag: Your frozen eyes smile

lines.narration: His ladder smashes your *jar*.
lines.scene: Slow motion: the ladder clips the jar, glass bursts, the five glowing words fly up into the caption under the picture. Gary: shocked.
lines.camera: Slow motion on the jar
lines.gag: The words fly into the caption

lines.narration: Your words land in my captions, and I read captions out loud. I can't *help* it!
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The words click into the caption one by one: IN / THIS / WORLD / YOU'RE / FREE. The giant sign shakes, trying to shut its eyes.
lines.camera: Insert on the caption filling, cut to the sweating sign
lines.gag: The words click into place like tiles

lines.narration: "In this world... you're... *free*."
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The edge of the frame shatters like a windscreen; light pours in; colour floods back into you and you unfreeze. Gary drops his mug. Face: shocked -> excited.
lines.camera: Push in as the frame edge shatters
lines.gag: The frame edge shatters like glass

lines.narration: You dive through the crack, straight out of the *video*.
lines.scene: You dive through the broken frame edge in slow motion, grinning; Gary waves goodbye with his empty mug. Face: excited, blush.
lines.camera: Follow the dive through the crack
lines.gag: Gary waves goodbye with his mug

lines.narration: Into the next one. Loop *one*.
lines.scene: You land in a brand-new 'In this world' video: a pink street where everyone is a pigeon, a fresh red bar at zero, a pigeon with a tiny ladder walking by. Face: crying -> scheming; you raise your fist at the edge of the screen.
lines.camera: Hold on you, tiny push as the fist comes up
lines.gag: The next video's Gary is a pigeon with a tiny ladder
